Description
The Philoro 50 gram Gold Bar is a premium gold bullion product crafted by LBMA-certified refiners, offering investors exceptional purity and assurance of quality. With a fineness of .9999, this gold bar represents one of the purest forms of investment-grade gold available in the precious metals market. Each bar originates from Austria or Switzerland and comes with a numbered certificate, guaranteeing its authenticity and traceability.
Manufactured by Valcambi S.A. on Behalf of Philoro
This gold bar is produced by Valcambi S.A., a renowned Swiss refinery, on behalf of Philoro, a reputable precious metals company based in Austria. Valcambi S.A. is accredited by the London Bullion Market Association (LBMA), adhering to the highest standards of quality and ethical sourcing. The “CHI – ESSAYEUR FONDEUR” hallmark stamped on each bar signifies its compliance with international assay standards and confirms its LBMA certification.
Secure Packaging and Verification
Each Philoro 50 gram Gold Bar is sealed in protective assay packaging that includes an assay card. The card mirrors the information engraved on the bar itself, such as weight, purity, and a unique serial number. This straightforward and attractive packaging ensures the bar’s authenticity can be easily verified, providing peace of mind to investors.
